scope.summary: Add the Detail group on the deterministic native engine: Capture sharpening (Amount, Radius, Detail, Masking); Luminance NR (Luminance, Luminance Detail, Luminance Contrast); Color NR (Color, Color Detail, Color Smoothness); and a grain-preserving noise-addition control. Deduped equivalent of Affinity Detail Refinement / Noise Reduction / Noise Addition. Detail ops are deterministic and MUST NOT be conflated with the AI-model Enhance denoise path ([STU-RAW-014], MT-428).
acceptance_criteria: deterministic sharpen/NR/noise-add; distinct from ML Enhance; Argus + manual
proof_targets: deterministic detail ops test + separation-from-ML assertion
expected_tests: test: capture-sharpen + luminance/color NR + noise-addition deterministic under fixed process version
test: deterministic Detail path distinct from ML Enhance denoise

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Detail (sharpen & noise)

risk_if_missed: No deterministic sharpening/NR; only ML path would exist (adapter conflation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
